turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon and thank you for contacting AcmeBrands! Can I have your name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I trying to see when you guys get your stock back in. Because everytime i try to order something its out of stock

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: David Williams

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I apologize for some of our items being out stock. Was there a specific item you were looking to order, David?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for David Williams.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes i was looking at the Guess Jacket and i'vre been looking for over a month and it always saying out of stock

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just don't understand!

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A reason of Guess Jacket has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry you've had to wait this long. I'll write a report and let our Purchasing Department know about this issue so that it can be corrected.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: The purchasing department has been notified.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you know when it will be in stock, Why have it on the site if we can't buy it?>

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The product is very popular and the supplier is trying to keep up with demand.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay still make it right but i will try back another time. Hopefully it will be in stoke then

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can place a back-order for it, if you would like, and then it would ship to you as soon as it became available.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yes that would be great!

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A purchase of Guess Jacket was made.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It will use the cred card that you currently have on your account for the purchase.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ok

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that will be all

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, I hope you have a wonderful day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: you too
